title: Split screen: three and four local players
summary: Multiplayer → Split Screen now takes 2, 3 or 4 local players with quarter views, per-controller seats, and per-player ATV/rider rows; Freestyle, races (3–4 players race without CPUs, as the manual specifies), King of the Hills, Treasure Hunt, Hockey and Tag.
details: fixed only the last rider being drawn with 3–4 players; host-only perf at 1280x720: CPU draw 1P 2.9 ms, 2P 3.9, 3P 7.0, 4P 6.9 ms (headless desktop Chromium, not a phone). Tests: browser split_4p, split_screen, split_games, split_tag, menu_flows, front pass.
